description: This file contains shell script functions and configurations related to platform-specific upgrade procedures for embedded devices, specifically for a device codenamed 'pistachio-marduk.' It handles image checks and upgrade processes including partition management and environment setup.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the given image is compatible with the current platform by calling nand_do_platform_check.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the platform-specific upgrade process, determining current boot partition, marking the next boot, and performing the NAND upgrade.
